fields.candidate_filename: bounded sibling temporary filename previously persisted by MarkReportVerifying; no directory, absolute path or traversal components
fields.artifact_filename: bounded final published filename only; no directory, absolute path or traversal components
fields.artifact_sha256: sha256 hex of the exact bytes verified and atomically published

rules: this proof is constructed only after SLA_REPORT_XLSX_V1 verifier returns VALID for the exact candidate/report_attempt_id/snapshot_hash and the filesystem adapter atomically publishes those same verified bytes to artifact_filename within the already-validated destination context
candidate_filename must equal the current unverified artifact_filename stored while attempt state=verifying before completion overwrites it with the final published artifact_filename
atomic publication must preserve the verified bytes exactly; if the final destination cannot be proven to contain the same artifact_sha256/artifact_size_bytes, no completion proof exists
the proof contains filename identities only and never carries a filesystem path or grants path authority

fields.snapshot_hash: sha256 hex of the sealed REPORT_SNAPSHOT_V1 generation

rules: the durable worker assigns one UUID command_id to this exact verifying -> completed authority transition before first invocation and reuses it on every retry
artifact_completion.report_attempt_id and snapshot_hash must equal the top-level request exactly
COMMAND_ENVELOPE_V1 request_hash binds report_attempt_id, expected_attempt_revision, exact sealed snapshot_hash and every artifact_completion field
exact committed replay is resolved before current state/revision/artifact checks so a crash after the completed commit safely returns the same ReportAttemptV1 without repeating completion or audit
the command performs no filesystem I/O inside its database UnitOfWork; it accepts only the already-verified, already-atomically-published exact artifact identity
